metality.screen.title: Metality Engine & Video Settings
metality.common.right_click_reset: Right-click any option to reset to default
metality.opt.render_distance.desc: Controls chunk radius rendered in the world and ray-tracing TLAS.
metality.opt.simulation_distance.desc: Controls radius for entity AI, redstone, and random ticks.
metality.opt.entity_distance.desc: Scales visibility distance of mobs and entities.
metality.opt.chunk_fade.desc: Smooth fade-in duration in seconds when new terrain sections arrive.
metality.opt.exclusive_fullscreen.desc: Use exclusive fullscreen mode when supported.
metality.opt.mac_menu.desc: Keep macOS menu bar accessible in fullscreen.
metality.opt.vsync.desc: Synchronize CAMetalLayer presentation to display refresh rate.
metality.opt.max_fps.desc: Cap frame rate or unlock for 120Hz ProMotion.
metality.opt.inactivity_fps.desc: Reduce framerate when minimized or AFK to lower heat and power.
metality.opt.gui_scale.desc: Scale menus and HUD elements cleanly.
metality.opt.fov_effects.desc: Strength of FOV changes during sprinting or speed effects.
metality.opt.autosave.desc: Display icon when saving the world.
metality.opt.graphics_preset.desc: Apply Minecraft Fast / Fancy / Fabulous baseline presets.
metality.opt.ao.desc: Enable soft ambient occlusion at block corners.
metality.opt.cutout_leaves.desc: Render leaf blocks with cutout transparency.
metality.opt.improved_transparency.desc: Improved blending for translucent vanilla geometry.
metality.opt.entity_shadows.desc: Render simple ground shadows beneath entities.
metality.opt.clouds.desc: Vanilla cloud mode (automatically replaced by volumetric clouds when Aperture shaders are active).
metality.opt.cloud_range.desc: Distance in chunks to render clouds.
metality.opt.weather_radius.desc: Range around camera where rain and snow render.
metality.opt.biome_blend.desc: Smooth color blending across biome borders.
metality.opt.mipmap.desc: Reduces distant texture shimmering and aliasing.
metality.opt.tex_filter.desc: Select None, RGSS, or Anisotropic texture filtering.
metality.opt.anisotropy.desc: Max anisotropy multiplier when Anisotropic Filtering is enabled.
metality.opt.menu_blur.desc: Background blur intensity behind in-game menus.
metality.opt.chunk_priority.desc: Prioritize player-affected or nearby chunk section rebuilds.
metality.opt.hwrt.desc: Enable Apple Silicon M3-M5 Metal BVH acceleration for shadows, GI, reflections and NEE lights.
metality.opt.hwrt.unsupported: Hardware BVH unavailable on this GPU; Voxel DDA fallback active.
metality.opt.edr.desc: Use 16-bit extended linear sRGB CAMetalLayer for true HDR headroom on Retina XDR displays.
metality.opt.render_scale.desc: Scale intermediate ray-traced and volumetric buffers while keeping full native output sharpness.
metality.opt.thermal.desc: Automatically scales internal shader resolution under macOS thermal pressure to sustain FPS.
metality.opt.frames_in_flight.desc: 2 frames reduces input latency; 3 frames maximizes Apple GPU throughput.
metality.opt.suppress_water.desc: Suppress blocky vanilla water meshes so Aperture ray-traced waves and refraction render seamlessly.
metality.opt.connected_glass.desc: Seamlessly connects adjacent glass blocks, tinted glass, stained glass, and glass panes with crisp outer frames and inner corners (works with or without shader packs).
metality.opt.dynamic_lights.desc: Inject player held items and glowing entities as live NEE point lights.
metality.opt.ripples.desc: Emit real-time water ripples from paddling boats and players entering water.
metality.opt.telemetry_hud.desc: Display FPS, GPU frame ms, UMA usage and thermal state in top-left corner.
metality.opt.live_preview.desc: Dim menu backdrop lightly in Shader Pack Settings to preview changes live in-world.
metality.opt.flush_pso.desc: Write compiled MTLBinaryArchive PSOs to disk immediately.
metality.opt.reset_engine.desc: Restore recommended Metality Apple Silicon defaults.
metality.shaders.empty:
No shader packs found in shaderpacks/
Drop any Aperture (pack.ts) or Iris (.zip / folder) pack here to import
metality.shaders.drop_hint: Drag & drop .zip or shader pack folders here to import
metality.shaders.none_active: No shader pack active (using Vanilla Metal pipeline)
metality.pack_settings.title: Shader Pack Settings
metality.shader_opt.BLOOM_STRENGTH.desc: Multi-mip HDR bloom glow intensity around bright highlights and emissives.
metality.shader_opt.BLOOM_THRESHOLD.desc: Minimum luminance required before pixels bleed bloom.
metality.shader_opt.HIGHLIGHT_BOOST.desc: Boost bright sunlit highlights independently of shadows.
metality.shader_opt.SHADOW_DEPTH.desc: Darkness depth of shadowed and cave regions for stronger contrast.
metality.shader_opt.EMISSIVE_INTENSITY.d: Intensity of lava, torches, sea lanterns and glowing blocks.
metality.shader_opt.ATMOS_HAZE.desc: Distance aerial perspective and horizon haze thickness.
metality.shader_opt.GODRAY_STRENGTH.desc: Strength of 3D sunbeams and stained-glass volumetric light shafts.
metality.shader_opt.WATER_CLARITY.desc: Underwater light transmission and depth visibility.
metality.shader_opt.WATER_WAVE_HEIGHT.de: Amplitude of randomized 3D water surface waves.
metality.shader_opt.WATER_RIPPLE_STRENGT: Amplitude of interactive boat wake and splash ripples.
metality.shader_opt.SPECULAR_STRENGTH.de: Intensity of metallic and glossy PBR specular highlights.
Intensity of glass, metal, ice and water environment reflections.
metality.shader_opt.RT_QUALITY.desc: Ray count multiplier for shadows and 1-bounce GI.
metality.shader_opt.SHADOW_QUALITY.desc: Controls shadow map cascade count and atlas resolution (Low 768 / Med 1024 / High 2x1280 / Ultra 2x2048).
metality.shader_opt.ENABLE_SHADOWS.desc: Enable real-time directional cascade/raytraced shadows. Turn off for max FPS.
metality.shader_opt.ENABLE_REFLECTIONS.d: Enable reflections on water, glass, metals, and rain puddles.
Enable 3D waves, refraction, and caustics. Turn off to restore vanilla Minecraft water.
metality.shader_opt.ENABLE_VOLUMETRIC_CL: Enable raymarched 3D clouds in the Overworld sky.
metality.shader_opt.ENABLE_GODRAYS.desc: Enable radial sunbeam shafts and colored stained-glass rays.
metality.shader_opt.ENABLE_BLOOM.desc: Enable multi-mip HDR bloom glow around highlights and emissives.
metality.shader_opt.ENABLE_GI_AO.desc: Enable 1-bounce color bleeding / GTAO + SSGI diffuse indirect lighting.
metality.shader_opt.ENABLE_PBR_RAIN.desc: Enable metallic/gem GGX specular highlights and wet rainstorm puddles.
